# Handoff template

## Actual state

- Task/stage and requirement IDs:
- Outcome implemented or documentation written:
- Files changed and unfinished edits:
- Input/contract revisions:
- Working-tree ownership or concurrent changes:

## Evidence

- Exact commands and runtime/environment:
- Results, counts, failures and explicit skips:
- Financial/source reconciliation:
- Visual/interaction checks, if relevant:
- Migration/backup/restore evidence, if relevant:

## Remaining work

- Known limitations and unavailable capabilities:
- Open question IDs and what they block:
- Safe next bounded task and relevant documents:
- Actions not authorised (commit/deploy/Live access etc.):

Never describe an unrun check as passed. Never include credentials or raw account data.
